text:
emma: Quick heads-up — planning to deprecate the legacy sync client (python sync v1) next Wednesday at 11:00 PT. Goal: publish py/ts v2 GA, mark v1 as soft-deprecated (npm/pypi deprecate notice), and flip default docs to v2. Need owners for publish, canaries, and rollback plan.

jordy: SGTM. Are we doing staged canaries across regions or just cohort canaries by org?

emma: Cohort canaries first (10% of new installs, `canary` dist-tag), then region sweep if stable. No automated forced migration — users can opt in.

samir: I can run the canary cohort and watch the SDK error rate. Will add logging hooks to the client for a 7-day telemetry window.

ben: For publishing: I propose this sequence:
1) publish `redwood-sync@2.0.0-canary.{ts}` to npm (dist-tag `canary`).
2) upload wheels to PyPI as `2.0.0rc1` (not yanked).
3) run internal smoke and perf harness.
If all green promote to `latest`/GA.

maria: Add docs redirect: docs.redwood.com/sdks/sync -> v2 quickstart. I can own the redirect and the release notes. Need the final changelog by Tue EOD.

qa: Checklist for canary/blocker gates:
- unit + integration smoke ✅
- regression smoke for token usage ✅
- latency bench (p95) within 10% of v1 ✅
- no new fatal exceptions in 24h ✅
If any fail, do immediate rollback.

emma: Rollback plan (short):
- npm: `npm dist-tag add redwood-sync@1.4.3 latest` (retag previous stable),
- PyPI: yank 2.x prereleases and re-upload 1.4.3 as `latest` wheel if needed (samir/ben to coordinate),
- Docs: switch redirect back, post status in #devex and tag customers who opted in.

release-bot: Publish job started: `redwood-sync@2.0.0-canary.1717000000` -> npm (pkg-id 0x7f5a)

samir: I'll standby for rollback commands. If we see any >5% error spike or auth regressions we'll retag.

release-bot: Canary publish succeeded for npm (pkg-id 0x7f5a). PyPI upload started.

ben: PyPI upload complete: wheel `redwood_sync-2.0.0rc1-py3-none-any.whl` uploaded to test PyPI. Kicking off perf harness: `./scripts/perf_run --suite sync-v1-vs-v2 --runs 50`

qa: Perf results quick glance: p95 v2 = 1.12x v1, p50 equal. Looks within threshold but will run longer smoke.

emma: Good. Maria — can you prepare the deprecation blurb for release notes? Keep actionable migration steps, copy/paste install lines, and mention timeline for hard removal (TBD but >90 days).

maria: Draft incoming. Will include: `pip install redwood-sync==2.0.0rc1` and `npm install @redwood/sync@canary` examples, migration snippet for replacing sync client init, and note about telemetry opt-out.

devex-oncall: FYI I'll monitor SLO dashboards during the rollout window and be ready to page on-call infra if we see GPU OOMs or autoscaler issues.

jordy: Minor ask — pin guidance for downstream infra: recommend `^2.0.0` or exact pin? I vote for exact pin for the first 2 weeks.

emma: Exact pin for production apps during initial 2-week window. After that we can recommend minor-range `~2.0`. Add that to release notes.

qa: If rollback occurs, someone please paste the exact npm + pip commands in this thread so ops can run them quickly.

ben: Copying rollback commands here for quick-run:
```
# npm retag
npm dist-tag add redwood-sync@1.4.3 latest
# PyPI yank + re-upload (if necessary)
twine upload dist/redwood_sync-1.4.3-py3-none-any.whl
```

samir: I'll also keep a pre-built artifact of 1.4.3 in the release bucket so re-deploy is immediate.

maria: Draft release notes posted: https://internal.docs/release/172-py-ts-sync-deprec — pls review.

emma: Thanks everyone. Next steps: Ben/Release-bot will promote to `latest` after 48h of canary health. Maria will publish release notes and docs redirect. Samir + QA standby for rollback. I will post final remind Tuesday morning. :thumbsup:
